manualChecks.note: Font metadata and OS/2 embedding bits do not establish permission to distribute approved binaries from a public repository or as webfonts.
The assigned Marlin files identify themselves as FSP DEMO builds and carry preview/print-only embedding metadata; production replacements are required before release.
Only Medium 500 and Semibold 600 are assigned approved production roles; all other checked-in Moanslight weights are unassigned.
Unassigned files are not defective; they are not authorized for CSS declaration or network delivery.
The audit generates candidate-only metric overrides. They are not canonical or applied until owner-approved browser proof satisfies every locked stability check.
